transportRecheck.question: Has eurolive.jp gained a working HTTPS endpoint since the 2026-08-25 check?
transportRecheck.method: Independent TLS-layer checks against eurolive.jp:443 using curl (schannel) and OpenSSL 3.5.5 s_client, across TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3, performed fresh on 2026-08-26.
transportRecheck.result: No. Both client stacks completed the TCP connection but the server aborted the TLS handshake before any certificate exchange with a server-originated 'tlsv1 alert internal error' (TLS alert 80), identical to the prior finding. HTTPS remains unavailable.
transportRecheck.disposition: HTTP-only remains the current transport. Each HTTP official source below carries its own httpOnlyOfficial waiver with issuerDomain eurolive.jp, httpsCheckedAt 2026-08-26, and this session's independent liveEndpointCheck as httpsUnavailableEvidence; no waiver was copied from the 2026-08-25 report.
